elements.name: Verify selection of SBI Home Loan

steps.name: the user is on the Magic Bricks homepage
the user clicks on the "SBI Home Loans" link in the Home Loans Menu bar
the user enters the loan amount in the "5000000" field
the user enters a valid mobile number in the "9876543210" field
the user enters a valid value in "mum" field
the user selects the city where the property is located from the Property City dropdown
the user selects the appropriate option for Is Property Finalized? "Yes"
the user selects the appropriate option for Is Token Amount Paid "No"
the user clicks on the "Check Eligibility" button
the user should be redirected to the Mobile Number Verification page

elements.name: Verify selection of SBI Home Loan

steps.name: the user is on the Magic Bricks homepage
the user clicks on the "SBI Home Loans" link in the Home Loans Menu bar
the user enters the loan amount in the "3000000" field
the user enters a valid mobile number in the "912346789" field
the user enters a valid value in "pun" field
the user selects the city where the property is located from the Property City dropdown
the user selects the appropriate option for Is Property Finalized? "Yes"
the user selects the appropriate option for Is Token Amount Paid "No"
the user clicks on the "Check Eligibility" button
the user should be redirected to the Mobile Number Verification page

elements.name: Verify navigation to City Selection Page

steps.name: user is on Magic Bricks homepage
the user clicks on the "Home Loans" link in the navigation bar
the user should be redirected to the Home Loans page
the user scrolls down on the Home Loans Page
the user clicks on "Claim Now" button on SBI Home Loan Offer
the user should be redirected to the MagicLoans page
the user scrolls down on the MagicLoans Page
the user clicks on "Get Started-->" button
the user clicks on one of the cities
the user clicks on "Next" button to generate signup form

elements.name: Calculate Home Loan EMI with data from Excel

steps.name: I am on the home page
I navigate to the home loans menu
I click on the home loan EMI calculator
I calculate EMI for all rows in Excel
I should see the recalculated EMI
